title: Neuro-Agentic Control: A Deep Learning-based LLM-Powered Agentic AI Framework for Controlling Security Controls

claim.summary: Neuro-Agentic Control pairs TimesFM forecasts with an LLM proposing bounded draining actions and rejects interventions that fail deterministic projected-risk checks.

modules.name: Bounded draining proposals and forecast perturbation
modules.scope_reason: Actions are constrained tank drain rates/durations; risk is max projected tank level after an explicit additive intervention rule.
